global_rules.instagram_clickable_link_rule: Do not rely on URLs in captions being clickable. Use profile link hub and Stories link sticker; keep the exact original tracking URL.
global_rules.publish_gate: Do not publish if account-specific Meta credentials, media URL, or eligible verified affiliate links are missing. Record as blocked, not successful.
global_rules.credentials: Separate account-specific Meta user IDs and access tokens in GitHub Actions secrets; never reuse another brand's token.
